article:
Five sentences have been removed from the text below. For each question, choose the correct answer. There are three extra sentences which you do not need to use.
Jamie Marshall - teenage magician!
Doing magic tricks is not something that only older people enjoy. I've just been in a competition for teenage magicians - and lots of people my age took part. But the best thing was - I won! I did a trick involving taking a ring from someone in the audience. 16______ Both the audience and the judges were really impressed by that unusual way of ending the trick.
My interest in magic started with a child's magic set that I got for my birthday a few years ago. I began practising a lot, doing tricks whenever I had a spare moment. 17______ But that never happened, and I went on to develop lots of new tricks.
My grandad loves magic, too. He was always doing things like producing coins from behind my ear - his way of giving me pocket money! 18______ So he never showed me any of his secrets and I just had to find out for myself!
I also loved performing tricks for friends at school. And as I got better, I started performing at events like family weddings and parties. At first, I thought I'd be really nervous, but in fact, I've always been completely relaxed when I'm performing. 19______
What made the biggest difference to my routine, however, was taking up drama classes when I was 15. That really helped a lot. It would be great if I could work in the world of magic when I get older - and even become a famous magician! I'm not really sure what my future will hold, though. I might go into acting instead. 20______ But whatever I end up doing, I know I'm going to really enjoy it!

sentences.label: A
sentences.text: And I don't think I'd be so confident now without their help.

sentences.label: B
sentences.text: My parents probably thought I'd get bored with it after a while.

sentences.label: D
sentences.text: I still needed to do some more work on that, though.

sentences.label: E
sentences.text: It's surprising really, as I used to be quite shy!

sentences.label: F
sentences.text: The next time they saw it, it was inside a melon that I'd cut open.

sentences.label: G
sentences.text: He made me start thinking about all sorts of possibilities.

sentences.label: H
sentences.text: But of course, people who do magic tricks never tell you how they're done.

explanations.16: Jamie表演戒指魔术，F选项“The next time they saw it, it was inside a melon that I'd cut open.”（戒指出现在切开的甜瓜里）描述魔术结局，与“unusual way of ending the trick”呼应。
explanations.17: Jamie常练习魔术，B选项“My parents probably thought I'd get bored with it after a while.”（父母以为他会很快厌倦）说明家人预期，与“but that never happened”形成转折。
explanations.18: 爷爷玩魔术但保守秘密，H选项“But of course, people who do magic tricks never tell you how they're done.”（魔术师从不透露秘密）解释原因，与“never showed me any secrets”衔接。
explanations.19: 表演时放松，E选项“It's surprising really, as I used to be quite shy!”（曾害羞，这很意外）说明反差，与“always been completely relaxed”呼应。
explanations.20: 考虑从事表演，C选项“That would be cool!”（那会很酷）表达期待，与“might go into acting instead”衔接。
